summary: "Labeling a child as a “failure” is a criminal act against that child. For a child, who has learned so much from life before entering school, to be labeled a failure...is unfair – to say the least; it is really outrageous." -Munir Fasheh #quote
author: Greg McVerry
body_html:
"Labeling a child as a “failure” is a criminal act against that child. For a child, who has learned so much from life before entering school, to be labeled a failure...is unfair – to say the least; it is really outrageous."
-Munir Fasheh
#quote
